trap.label: do without
trap.wrong: We can do without of the second table.
trap.right: We can do without the second table.
trap.why: Por “passar sem”, o brasileiro acrescenta of/de. Em inglês, do without + substantivo.

mcq.q: We can do ___ the second table.

opts: We can do without of it.

fix.wrong: We can do without of coffee.
She did the zip up of her coat.
We can’t do with the car.
fix.right: We can’t do without the car.

rewrite.prompt: Use do without: “We can manage without a table.”
rewrite.answer: We can do without a table.

rewrite.prompt: Use do up: “She closed her coat.”
